items.hed: Texans play Jacksonville in London on Sunday, 8:30 a.m. Central
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Sunday, Oct. 18, as an away game against the Jacksonville Jaguars at Wembley Stadium, kickoff 8:30 a.m. Central, on NFL Network. Sunday's game at Tennessee is behind them on the club page, which does not print a final, so none is stated here. The next home date is Oct. 25 against the New York Giants, noon Central, on FOX. The club page now calls the home ground Reliant Stadium.

items.hed: Astros are out of the 2026 postseason; the ALCS is Rays and Guardians
items.insight: MLB.com reported that Houston was the first team eliminated from the 2026 postseason after winning the American League West on the final day of the regular season. The league's postseason page lists the Dodgers, Brewers, Rays, and Guardians in the League Championship Series. Tuesday's listed game is Cleveland at Tampa Bay, Game 2, at 8 p.m. Eastern. Houston is not on that card.

items.hed: Rockets open the season at home against Dallas on Oct. 21
items.insight: The Rockets' official schedule note says opening night, presented by Toyota, is against Dallas on Oct. 21. No tip time is printed on that note, so none is stated here. The club is not in season yet.
